Here is the update for the team. We finished the first part of the migration on Monday, and it went mostly fine. There were two problems. The old export script kept timing out on the large tables, so we split it into smaller batches, and that fixed it. A few records had dates in the wrong format, and we cleaned those up by hand, which took most of Tuesday. After that we ran the full comparison between the old system and the new one, and the numbers matched except for three rows, which we are still looking into. This week we will finish those three rows, move the reports over, and turn off the old system on Friday. Please test your own reports on the new system before Thursday so we catch anything strange before the switch. If you find a problem, write down the report name and what looked wrong, and send it to me directly. Thanks, everyone, for the hard work on this.
